Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

at least adverb

also at any rate, at the very least, if nothing else, in any case, at a minimum

classical

Ter. Eun. 638–639: sī illud nōn licet, saltem hoc licēbit
Cic. Att. 9.6.5: ēripe mihi hunc dolōrem aut minue saltem
Traupman 338

saltem

adverb, after the word it limits

at least, at all events

What still holds when something greater is refused: “if not that, at least this”.

Other words

  • certē — at least, at any rate; surely

    adverb · also used · classical · Phaedr. 4 epil. 7: sī nōn ingenium, certē brevitātem approbā; Quint. 1.1.11: at ūnus certē sit assiduus loquendī nōn imperītus

  • minimum — at least (with numbers)

    adverb · also used · classical · Varr. RR 2.1.12: minimum octōgintā et ūna (Lewis & Short); Plin. NH 18.146 (Lewis & Short)

  • utique — at any rate, at least; above all

    adverb · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 13.48.2: velim M. Varrōnis et Ollī mittās laudātiōnem, Ollī utique; Traupman 338

    In Cicero mostly in the letters (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • sī illud nōn licet, saltem hoc licēbit

    if that isn’t allowed, at least this will beTer. Eun. 638–639

  • ēripe mihi hunc dolōrem aut minue saltem

    take this pain away from me, or at least make it lessCic. Att. 9.6.5

  • sī nōn ingenium, certē brevitātem approbā

    if not my talent, at least approve my brevityPhaedr. 4 epil. 7

See also least.
